The directions of Cranberry Cake are: Blend shortening and eggs.; Add flour, baking powder, soda and salt.; Mix and add sour cream, mix separately the nuts, cinnamon and sugar.; Mix cranberry sauce up a bit.; Use a tube or Bundt pan.; Put 1/2 of batter in greased pan, put in 1/2 of the nut mix and 1/2 of cranberry sauce.; Put in remaining ingredients, nut mix and spread cranberry sauce on top.; Bake at 350° for 45 minutes..

The directions of Cranberry Cake are: Preheat oven to 350°.; Put the chopped cranberries, walnuts and 1/2 cup of sugar in a buttered 10-inch pie plate or spring-form pan.; Mix the eggs, melted and cooled butter, 1 cup of sugar, flour, salt and almond extract.; Stir the batter until it is smooth and pour it over cranberry walnut mixture.; Bake the cake in the middle of the oven for 40 minutes or until tester comes out clean..

The directions of Cranberry Cake are: Mix cranberries, sugar and nuts.; Put in a 9 x 9-inch cake pan in which margarine has been melted.; In a separate bowl, beat eggs.; Add flour, sugar and 1/2 cup margarine.; Pour over cranberry-nut mixture and bake 1 hour at 325°.; Can be served warm with whipped cream or cold with ice cream..

The directions of Cranberry Cake are: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.; Grease a 9" tube pan.; Line bottom with parchment paper.; Sift together flour, sugar, baking soda and salt into a large bowl.; Reserve 1/4 cup cranberry sauce fort the frosting.; Add remaining cranberry sauce, nuts, mayonnaise and orange rind to the flour mixture.; Mix well.; Stir in orange juice.; Pour into tube pan and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes.; Remove from pan and cool and frost.; To make frosting, soften the butter.; Add sugar and cranberry sauce.; Beat until creamy and frost the cooled cake..

The directions of Cranberry Cake are: Cream 3 tablespoons butter and 1 1/2 cups sugar.; Beat vanilla.; Combine flour, salt and baking powder.; Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture, alternately with 1 1/2 cups milk. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan.; Bake at 400° for 35 minutes..

The directions of Cranberry Cake are: Beat eggs well, then add next 8 ingredients.; Stir in remaining ingredients, just until well blended.; Pour into well-greased and floured Bundt pan.; Bake 1 hour at 350°.; Cool and remove from pan.; Good as is but better frosted with a cream cheese frosting..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in water.; Add the sugar, salt and enough flour to make a soft dough.; Turn onto a floured board, knead until smooth and elastic, about 6 to 8 minutes.; Pinch off about 2 tablespoons of dough for each pretzel.; Shape into traditional pretzel twists or other shape as desired.; Place on greased baking sheets.; Brush with egg, sprinkle with salt.; Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until golden brown.; Cool on wire rack..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: Preheat oven to 450°.; Dissolve yeast in warm water, add sugar and salt.; Blend in flour.; Knead until smooth.; Cut into 10 to 12 pieces, roll into ropes and twist into desired shapes.; Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet.; Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with coarse salt.; Bake at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water in a large bowl, and let stand for 5 minutes.; Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups, level with a knife. Add 3 cups flour and 1 teaspoon salt to yeast mixture, stir until a soft dough forms. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface, knead until smooth and elastic (about 8 minutes). Add enough of remaining flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, to prevent dough from sticking to hands (dough will feel slightly sticky).; Place dough in a large bowl coated with cooking spray, turning to coat top. Cover and let rise in a warm place (85°), free from drafts, 40 minutes or until doubled in size. (Gently press two fingers into dough. If indentation remains, the dough has risen enough.) Punch dough down, cover and let rest 5 minutes.; Preheat oven to 425°.; Divide dough into 12 equal portions. Working with one portion at a time (cover remaining dough to prevent drying), roll each portion into an 18-inch-long rope with tapered ends. Cross one end of rope over the other to form a circle, leaving about 4 inches at end of each rope. Twist the rope at the base of the circle. Fold the ends over the circle and into a traditional pretzel shape, pinching gently to seal. Place pretzels on a baking sheet lightly coated with cooking spray. Cover and let rise 10 minutes (pretzels will rise only slightly).; Combine 6 cups water and baking soda in a nonaluminum Dutch oven. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer. Gently lower 1 pretzel into simmering water mixture, cook 15 seconds. Turn pretzel with a slotted spatula, cook an additional 15 seconds. Transfer pretzel to a wire rack coated with cooking spray. Repeat procedure with remaining pretzels.; Place pretzels on a baking sheet sprinkled with cornmeal. Combine 1 teaspoon water and egg in a small bowl, stirring with a fork until smooth. Brush a thin layer of egg mixture over pretzels, sprinkle with kosher salt. Bake at 425° for 12 minutes or until pretzels are deep golden brown. Transfer to a wire rack to cool..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: If you have a bread machine, place all ingredients (except egg) in machine.; (If not, just knead away); Select "manual" and start machine.; When kneading cycle is complete, turn out on floured board.; Cut into 24 strips.; Roll each strip into 18 to 20 inch ropes.; Shape into pretzel and place on baking sheets.; Cover, let rise about 45 minutes.; Beat egg and water together, and brush each pretzel with eggwash.; Sprinkle with topping(s) of your choice (kosher salt, garlic or onion salt, parmesan cheese); Bake in preheated oven at 475 degrees (250 C.) for 12 minutes..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: Grease baking sheet and preheat oven to 425°.; Place cool water into small bowl and beat in egg.; Set aside.; In a large bowl, mix only 2 cups of the white flour, wheat flour, yeast and salt.; Add water, honey and oil (in this order).; Stir with a wooden spoon until combined.; Add enough of the set aside flour to make a soft dough.; Knead dough about 5 to 7 minutes.; Cut dough into 12 equal pieces.; Roll each piece into a rope.; Form pretzels and place on baking sheet.; Dough will contract a little, so enlarge holes with finger.; Brush each pretzel with your egg mixture.; Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: Preheat oven to 425°.; Dissolve yeast in 1 1/2 cups lukewarm water.; Add sugar and salt, stir until dissolved.; Add flour, mix well.; Turn out dough on floured board, knead for about 5 minutes. Roll into thin strips, shape into pretzels.; Place on well-greased cookie sheet.; Beat egg yolk with one tablespoon of water, brush on pretzels.; Sprinkle generously with coarse salt. Bake in oven for 15 to 20 minutes..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: In mixer bowl combine 2 cups of the flour and the yeast in saucepan heat milk, sugar, oil and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt just till warm (115 120) stir constantly.; Add to flour mixture.; Beat at low speed of electric mixer for 1/2 minute, scraping bowl.; Beat 3 minutes at high speed.; Stir in as much of he remaining flour as you can mix in with a spoon.; Turn out onto lightly floured surface.; Knead in enough of the remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough that is smooth and elastic (6-8 minutes) Shape into a ball.; Place in lightly greased bowl, turn once to grease surface.; Cover, let rise in warm place till double (about 1 1/2 hours) Punch down, turn out onto lightly floured surface, cover let rest 10 minutes.; Roll into a 12x8 inch rectangles.; Cut into 16 strips, each 12 inches long and 1/2 inch wide.; Roll each into a rope 16 inches long.; Shape into pretzels.; Let rise, uncovered, 20 minutes.; Dissolve 3 tablespoons salt in the boiling water.; Lower 3 or 4 pretzels at a time into boiling water, boil for 2 minutes, turning once.; Remove with slotted spoon to paper toweling, let stand a few seconds then place 1/2 inch apart on well greased baking sheet.; Brush with mixture of egg white and 2 tablespoons water.; Sprinkle lightly with sesame seed or coarse salt.; Bake in 350 oven 25 to 30 minutes or till golden brown..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: In a small bowl, dissolve yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar in warm water.; Let stand until creamy about 10 mins.; In a large bowl, mix together flour, 1/2 cup sugar, and salt.; Make a Well in the center, add the oil and yeast mixture.; Mix and form into a dough.; If the mixture is dry, add one or two tablespoons of water.; Knead the dough until smooth, about 7 to 8 mins.; Lightly oil a large bowl, place the dough in the bowl and turn to coat with oil.; Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size about 1 hour.; Preheat oven to 450F ( 230 C).; In a large bowl, dissolve baking soda in hot water.; When risen, turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and divide into 12 equal pieces.; Roll each piece into a rope and twist into a pretzel shape.; Once all of the dough is all shaped, dip each pretzel into the baking soda solution and place on a greased baking sheet.; Sprinkle with course salt.; Bake in preheated oven for 8 mins, until browned..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: Heat oven to 475°.; In a large bowl, mix the hot water and yeast until the yeast dissolves.; Stir in the warm water and the brown sugar.; Slowly add 5 cups of flour to the mixture, stirring constantly.; Continue stirring until the mixture is smooth and does not stick to the sides of the bowl.; Put the dough on a lightly floured board.; Dip your hands in the extra flour.; Knead the dough until it is stretchy and smooth.; Push it down and away from you with the palms of your hands.; Turn the dough as you work..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: Dissolve yeast and sugar in 1 cup warm water in a small bowl, let stand 5 minutes.; Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups, and level with a knife.; Combine 1 1/2 cups flour and salt in a large bowl.; Add butter, yeast mixture, and remaining 1 1/2 cups flour, stirring until a soft dough forms.; Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface, and knead until smooth and elastic (about 5 minutes).; Place dough in a large bowl coated with cooking spray, turning to coat top.; Cover and let rise in a warm place (85°), free from drafts, 40 minutes or until doubled in size. (Press two fingers into dough. If indentation remains, the dough has risen enough.); Punch dough down, divide into 12 equal portions.; Cover and let rest 10 minutes on a lightly floured surface.; Shape each portion of dough into an 18-inch rope with tapered ends, twist each rope into a pretzel shape.; Preheat oven to 450°.; Combine 4 cups water and baking soda in a large nonaluminum Dutch oven, bring to a boil.; Add 4 pretzels, cook 1 minute, turning once (do not overcrowd pan).; Remove pretzels with a slotted spoon, shake off excess water.; Place pretzels on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray, sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt evenly over pretzels.; Repeat procedure twice with remaining pretzels and salt.; Bake pretzels at 450° for 10 minutes or until golden brown.; Remove from pans to wire racks..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: Preheat oven to 425°F.; Set aside two baking sheets.; In a medium sized bowl, combine the warm water and yeast and mix for about one minute, until the yeast is dissolved.; Shape the dough into a small log and cut into 10 evenly sized pieces.; Roll each piece into a long, even rope (about 20 inches).; Make the pretzel shape by creating a U, then twist the ends across each other and press the dough together.; Lay pretzels on the baking sheets.; Make your egg wash in a small bowl and use a pastry brush to lightly coat the tops of the pretzels.; Sprinkle with course finishing salt and bake for 12-14 minutes until the tops are golden brown.; Let cool on the baking sheet for three minutes before transferring to a cooling rack.; Pretzels are best enjoyed the day that they are made, dipped in Mustard and Co.'s classic mustard..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: Pour 2 cups hot water into bowl of electric mixer with dough hook.; Check water with instant-read thermometer to register about 110 degrees.; Add sugar, stir to dissolve.; Sprinkle with yeast, let sit 5 minutes, yeast should bubble.; Beat 1 cup flour into yeast on low until combined.; Beat in salt and 4 cups flour until combined, about 30 seconds.; Beat on medium--low until doughy pulls away from sides of bowl, about 1 1/2 minutes.; Add 1/2 cup flour, and knead on low 1 minute more.; If dough is still wet and sticky, add 1/2 cup more flour (this will depend on weather conditions), knead until combined, about 30 seconds.; Transfer to a lightly floured board, and knead about 10 times until smooth.; Pour oil into a large bowl, swirl to coat sides.; Transfer dough to bowl, turning dough to completely cover all sides.; Cover with a kitchen towel, and leave in a warm spot for 1 hour, or until dough has doubled in size.; Heat oven to 450 degrees.; Lightly spray 2 baking sheets with cooking spray.; Set aside.; Punch down dough remove bubbles.; Transfer to a lightly floured board.; Knead once or twice, divide into 16 pieces (about 2 1/2 ounces each), and wrap in plastic.; Roll 1 piece of dough at a time into an 18 -- inch -- long strip.; Twist pretzel shape, transfer to prepared baking sheet.; Cover with a kitchen towel.; Continue to form pretzels, 8 will fit on each sheet.; Let dough rest until it rises slightly, about 15 minutes.; Meanwhile, fill large shallow pot with 2 inches water.; Bring to a boil.; Add baking soda.; Reduce to simmer, transfer 3 to 4 pretzels to water.; Poach 1 minute.; Use slotted spoon to transfer pretzels to baking sheet.; Continue until all pretzels are poached.; Beat egg with 1 tablespoon water.; Brush pretzels with egg wash. Sprinkle with salt.; Bake 12 to 15 minutes, until golden brown.; Let cool on wire rack.; Pretzels are best when eaten the same day, and will keep at room temperature, uncovered, for 2 days.; Do not store in covered container..

The directions of Soft Pretzels are: 'Proof' yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.; Scald 1 quart of milk.; Add shortening and sugar.; Stir 'til melted.; Let stand 'til lukewarm.; Add 6 cups of the flour and stir until smooth.; Cover.; Let rise in warm place, 30 minutes, until light and bubbly.; Stir down risen dough.; Beat in remaining flour, baking soda and salt.; Cover.; Let rise in greased bowl until double, about 1 1/2 hours.; Punch down.; Divide into 6 pieces.; Let rest 10 minutes.; Divide each piece further into 10 pieces.; Roll into rope 1/2" x 18".; Twist into pretzel.; Tuck ends under.; When all are shaped, cover lightly with a towel.; Dissolve 2/3 cups baking soda in 2 quarts cold water and bring to a boil in a pan that's NOT aluminum.; Lower pretzels into boiling solution on slotted spatula for 5 seconds and remove.; Drain.; Place on WAXED baking sheet (Put baking sheets in oven as you preheat. At about 250 degrees take the pans out then rub hard with waxed paper.).; Sprinkle pretzels with coarse salt.; Bake in 400 degree F oven for 15 minutes or until well-brown.; Makes 5 dozen 5" pretzels..
The directions of Tuna Patties are: Pour tuna in mixing bowl.
column2: Add the eggs and mix well.
column3: Crush the crackers real good and add to mixture.
column4: Add flour and mix well. Make into patties.
column5: Fry them in oil until golden brown..

column1: The directions of Tuna Patties are: Combine egg, tuna, tuna liquid, mustard, half the crumbs and relish in a bowl, mix well.; Shape into 4 patties.; Coat with remaining crumbs, fry in hot shortening for several minutes on each side until browned.; Serve on buns..

The directions of Tuna Patties are: Combine the tuna, bread crumbs, scallions, piemientos, egg, Worcestershire sauce, and salt in a medium bowl.; Shape into 4 patties about 4 inches in diameter.; Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet then add patties.; Cook until golden brown and cooked through, about 4 minutes on each side..
The directions of Tuna Patties are: Heat oil in skillet over medium heat.
column2: Mix all ingredients together except olive oil.
column4: Fry in oil until browned on each side.
column5: About 3 minutes per side..

column1: The directions of Tuna Patties are: Preheat oven to 375.; In a medium bowl combine drained tuna, seasoning, onion, egg whites and Panko bread crumbs. Mix well and shape into 8 patties.; Line baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with non-stick cooking spray.; Place patties on baking sheet and cook for 10 minutes.; Meantime make the spicy mayo by mixing mayo, sriracha sauce, and lime juice.; Chill in refrigerator..

The directions of Tuna Patties are: In a large bowl, combine the eggs, a third of the soup and 1/4 cup milk.; Stir in stuffing mix and tuna. Shape into eight patties.; In a large skillet, brown patties in butter for 3-4 minutes on each side or until heated through.; Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, heat remaining soup and milk.; Serve with patties..

The directions of Tuna Patties are: Drain tuna.; Remove the skin from the potato and break it up with a fork.; Mix tuna with onion, egg and potatoe.; Add a little salt and pepper.; Shape into medium sized patties.; Pour bread crumbs into a dish and roll patties in bread crumbs.; Deep fry in hot oil until browned Serve with ketchup..

The directions of Tuna Patties are: In a mixing bowl, combine chives, onion powder, garlic powder, sea salt, black pepper, paprika, parsley, thyme, dill, caraway seed and rosemary. Use a fork to crush the herbs and blend them together.; Add in onion and pepper and stir again.; Add tuna and egg and stir well.; Add approximately 3/4 c breadcrumbs and stir. Add more if needed to bind the mixture well.; Put remaining breadcrumbs in a shallow plate.; Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.; Form tuna mixture into 4 patties. Coat both sides in breadcrumbs and add to pan.; Cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes each side..
The directions of Tuna Patties are: Mix all ingredients together.
column2: Add just enough soup to make moist.
column3: Form patties and roll in bread crumbs.
column4: Spray Pam on both sides.
column5: Bake until brown.
column6: You may also brown these in a skillet on top of the stove.
column7: Just spray Pam in skillet as directed..

column1: The directions of Tuna Patties are: Drain and flake fish.
column2: Add all ingredients except flour and oil.
column3: (More wheat germ may be added if mixture is too wet.)
column4: Form into six 2-inch patties.
column5: Roll in flour and fry in a small amount oil (approximately 1/2 inch in skillet).

column1: The directions of Tuna Patties are: Combine ingredients in a bowl.
column2: Mix thoroughly.
column3: Add 1 1/2 tablespoons of water if mixture seems dry.
column4: Make patties..

column1: The directions of Tuna Patties are: Mix ingredients, except shortening, together and form into patties.; Melt shortening in heavy skillet and saute the patties until golden brown.; Drain on absorbent paper.; Serve hot with sauce or chill for several hours or overnight and serve cold with sour cream sauce..

The directions of Tuna Patties are: Combine all ingredients (except oil) into one bowl, season to taste and mix very well.; Form into patties (I got 10 patties out of 3 cans, but it depends on how big you decide to make them).; Heat oil in a large frying pan on medium heat.; Place 4 patties in the oil and cook until theyre golden and slightly crispy.; Flip patties and do the same for the other side.; Continue with the rest of the patties until finished.; Side note: Make sure to drain the tuna super well.; When forming the patties, some more juice may come out. Just squeeze it out and continue forming the patties..

The directions of Chocolate Truffle Pie are: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees.; Combine all the ingredients in a medium-size bowl and mix well.; Empty the mixture into an 8 1/2-inch heart-shaped tart form set on a large baking sheet.; Press the crumbs against the bottom and sides of the form to make an even layer, then refrigerate the crust 15 minutes.; Bake the crust 15 minutes or until crisp and dry.; Cool thoroughly then fill with the chocolate truffle cream..

The directions of Chocolate Truffle Pie are: In a microwave-safe dish, combine chocolate morsels and 1/2 cup cream, cook on HIGH for 1-2 minutes stirring every 30 seconds until smooth.; Cool to room temperature.; Stir in sugar and vanilla, set aside.; In a small mixing bowl, beat remaining cream until soft peaks form.; Beat in chocolate mixture on high, one-third at a time, mix well.; Spoon into crust.; Refrigerate for at least 3 hours..

The directions of Chocolate Truffle Pie are: For the crust: Preheat oven to 375F; In the bowl of a food processor, pulse graham crackers and sugar until finely ground.; Add melted butter and pulse until mixture is moistened.; Press into the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch pie dish.; Bake for 7 minutes.; Place pie dish on a cooling rack and let cool completely.; For the truffle filling: In a small saucepan set over medium heat bring the cream just to a simmer.; Place chocolate in a medium bowl and pour hot cream over chocolate.; Let stand for 1 minute then whisk until smooth.; Spread filling over the bottom of cooled crust.; Freeze for 20 minutes, or until firm.; For the whipped chocolate filling: Place chocolate, 1/2 cup of the cream, and vanilla in a microwave-safe bowl.; Microwave in 20-second bursts, stirring between each burst, until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth.; Do not overheat.; Let cool to room temperature.; In the bowl of an electric mixer beat the remaining 1 cup cream on medium speed until thick.; Add chocolate mixture and beat until soft peaks form.; Spread the whipped chocolate mixture over truffle filing in crust.; Refrigerate overnight.; For the whipped cream topping: Before serving, beat cream on medium speed until it begins to thicken.; Add confectioners' sugar and whip until stiff peaks form.; Spread whipped cream over top of pie.; Garnish with chocolate shavings and serve..

The directions of Chocolate Truffle Pie are: Heat oven to 325F.; Microwave chocolate and cream in microwaveable bowl on HIGH 2 min. or until chocolate is almost melted, stir until completely melted.; Cool.; Whisk in eggs, sugar and flour.; Pour into 9-inch pie plate sprayed with cooking spray.; Bake 35 min. or until edge of pie is puffed but center is still slightly soft, cool.; Serve topped with COOL WHIP..

The directions of Chocolate Truffle Pie are: Combine chocolate chips, cream cheese, and butter in microwave safe bowl.; Melt on 100% power for 30 seconds, then stir.; Repeat until smooth.; Stir in vanilla, triple sec and powdered sugar. Pour into pie shell.; Chill 6 hours or overnight.; Spoon sliced strawberries on top of pie and top with whipped toppings..

The directions of Chocolate Truffle Pie are: In a bowl, combine wafer crumbs and butter.; Press onto the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch pie plate coated with nonstick cooking spray.; Freeze for 30 minutes.; Spread chocolate ice cream over crust, freeze for 1 hour or until firm..

The directions of Chocolate Truffle Pie are: To prepare crust, combine crumbs, margarine, and sugar in a mixing bowl.; Press mixture firmly in a 9 inch pie pan.; Spread crumb mixture evenly in pie pan.; Chill 1 hour, or until firm.; Or, bake in a 375 oven for 10 minutes or until edges are brown.; Cool on rack before filling.; To prepare filling, combine gelatin and water in a saucepan.; Let stand one minute.; Over low heat, stir until gelatin is completely dissolved.; Cool.; In a mixing bowl, combine chocolate, sweetened condensed milk, gelatin mixture, and vanilla extract.; Mix well.; Fold in whipped topping.; Pour into crust.; Chill three hours or until set..
The directions of Salmon Roll are: Mix all ingredients together until smooth.
column2: Roll in chopped walnuts and parsley.
column3: Roll in foil or Saran Wrap.
column4: Chill well so they slice easily for your appetizer tray..

column1: The directions of Salmon Roll are: Combine salmon, cream cheese and liquid smoke or Worcestershire sauce, mix well.; Shape into ball or log.; Roll in mixture of pecans and parsley.; Roll up in plastic wrap or wax paper.; Chill to blend flavors.; Serve with crackers..
The directions of Salmon Roll are: Mix salmon, onion and sour cream and form into ball.; Roll in the pecans.; Chill and serve with crackers..
The directions of Salmon Roll are: Mix together well.
column2: Cover top with chopped pecans.

column1: The directions of Salmon Roll are: Sift flour with baking powder and 1 tsp salt into bowl.; Cut in shortening until fine crumbs are formed.; Add milk and stir with a fork to make a soft dough.; Turn dough onto lightly floured surface, knead gently for 8-10 times.; Roll into a 10 x; 12 inch rectangle..

The directions of Salmon Roll are: place your puff pastry on the counter for about 30 mins until thawed out.; preheat oven to 375 degrees.; debone your salmon.; chop onion (I use a food processor).; mix onion, salmon & seasonings.; spread your salmon mixture on top of the thawed out puff pastry.; if you chose to add spinach, put it on top of the salmon mix.; roll the pastry until the end when you have a "log".; pinch the ends so nothing leaks out.; use glass or aluminum oven safe pan and place in oven for about 30 minutes or until golden brown.; slice and enjoy!.

The directions of Salmon Roll are: Combine salmon and cream cheese, mixing well.; Stir in remaining ingredients, except pecans and parsley.; Chill well. Shape into 12-inch long log and roll in pecans and parsley. Roll up in foil or plastic wrap.; Chill well.; Serve with assorted crackers..
The directions of Salmon Roll are: Break salmon apart and drain.
column2: Stir in first 5 ingredients. Shape
column4: Chill several hours.
column5: Roll in parsley and pecans.

column1: The directions of Sticky Buns are: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.; (Can use Pam.); Sprinkle nuts in pan. Cut each thawed loaf into 12 or 14 pieces.; Fill pan with single layer.; Heat together all other ingredients (don't boil), pour over dough.; Let rise in refrigerator overnight.; Bake in preheated oven at 350°, for 30 minutes.; Cool, then invert to serve..

The directions of Sticky Buns are: Preheat oven to 350°.; Mix margarine, honey and brown sugar in bottom of a 9-inch pie pan.; Mix well and spread evenly in pan. Sprinkle raisins evenly over margarine mixture.; Arrange biscuits in pan.; Bake 20 minutes or until brown.; Remove from oven and let sit 1 minute.; Invert onto serving plate and serve warm..
The directions of Sticky Buns are: Make soft dough.
column2: Roll out in 8-inch squares.
column4: Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle on dough. Roll up and cut in 1-inch pieces.
column5: Combine butter and brown sugar in 8-inch dish.

column1: The directions of Sticky Buns are: Sprinkle pecans in Bundt or streusel pan, arrange rolls over pecans.; Sprinkle pudding mix, brown sugar and cinnamon over rolls.; Drizzle butter over all.; Cover and let sit on counter overnight (at least 6 hours).; Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes and then invert on serving plate..

The directions of Sticky Buns are: Defrost bread.; Combine pudding mix, cinnamon and brown sugar. Mix well.; Cut bread into small 2-inch balls.; Place some of mixture in bottom of Bundt pan.; Then a layer of bread balls, mixture and bread balls.; Layer until all gone..

The directions of Sticky Buns are: Add flour, water, butter, sugar, egg, yeast and gluten into bream machine and start it on dough setting.; Run hot bath and pour cup of coffee and relax for 90 minutes; When dough cycle ends, roll dough out on floured surface to 1/4 inch thick.; Spread dough with margarine.; Sprinkle cin/sugar mixture over butter and roll the dough.; Slice the roll into 1.5 inch thick slices and place in 2 greased 9 inch cake pans.; Set pans aside and let rise for about 40 minutes.; Bake at 350F for 30 minutes.; Remove & place on plates and cool completely.; Glaze.; Mix cream cheese, milk and powdered sugar until creamy and desired texture, if to thick, add more milk, if too thin, add more powdered sugar.; Drizzle over rolls..

The directions of Sticky Buns are: Thaw, but do not let bread raise.; Break 1 loaf up in the bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan.; Melt oleo.; Then add brown sugar, pudding mix, milk and cinnamon.; Mix all together, then pour over broken bread.; Break second loaf on top and let rise for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.; Bake approximately 30 minutes at 350°..

The directions of Sticky Buns are: Mix yeast and water.; Add sugar, salt, egg and flour.; Knead into soft dough.; Let rise 30 minutes.; Grease large cake pan. Spread with brown sugar, nuts and syrup.; Roll dough out in oblong shape 1/4-inch thick.; Spread with oil and 1/3 cup white sugar. Sprinkle with cinnamon.; Roll up.; Slice in 1-inch pieces.; Place cut side down in pan.; Let rise.; Bake at 350° for 20 minutes..

The directions of Sticky Buns are: Cut dough into 4 sections and then break into pieces as you dip into the following mixture.; Melt margarine, add sugar and cinnamon.; Place cherries and nuts into bottom of angel cake pan. Pour dough into pan.; Set oven at 200° and let dough rise for about 1 hour.; Bake at 350° until done..
The directions of Sticky Buns are: Soften loaves of bread.; Cut up into 1-inch pieces.; Roll into cinnamon and sugar mixture.; Place in Pam sprayed Bundt pan, piece by piece..

The directions of Sticky Buns are: Melt butter in an 8 x 1 1/2-inch round pan.; Add brown sugar and corn syrup, heat until sugar dissolves.; Sprinkle pecans over sugar mixture.; Place biscuits atop in a single layer.; Bake at 425° for about 15 minutes or until done.; Let stand 5 minutes. Invert, serve warm.; Makes 10..

The directions of Sticky Buns are: Combine yeast, milk, sugar, vinegar and 1 1/2 c. flour, allow to stand until bubbly.; Add salt, eggs, oil and second 1 1/2 c. flour.; Beat well, let rise until double in size.; Roll out 1/2 inch thick and spread with 1/4 c. melted butter, cinnamon, granulated sugar, and raisins if you desire.; Roll up and cut into 18 slices.; Mix 1 c. melted butter, brown sugar, and water, spread over bottom of pan and sprinkle with pecans.; Lay cut slices of dough over the syrup mix, and allow to rise.; Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.; Invert on cake rack to cool..

The directions of Sticky Buns are: In round baking dish, melt margarine 45 seconds on High.; Stir in sugar, syrup and cinnamon.; Add fruit and nuts and spread evenly.; Arrange biscuits around edge of dish.; Cook on High about 3 minutes just until biscuits spring back when pressed.; Invert dish on plate and let rest 1 minute, then remove dish..

The directions of Carbonara are: Cook bacon crisp, crumble into bits and set aside.; Drain fat from skillet.; Add butter and onion, cook until soft.; Stir in Prosciutto.; Add chicken broth and bacon..

The directions of Carbonara are: In a large pot of boiling, salted water, cook pasta according to packet directions.; Drain and keep warm.; Combine the evaporated milk and paprika in a small bowl.; Set aside.; In a separate bowl combine the eggs and cheese.; Set aside.; Heat the oil in the pot used to cook the pasta, add the bacon and cook over a high heat until done.; Remove from heat and add the milk mixture to the bacon.; Stir well and set aside.; In one pot combine the add the pasta and egg mixture to the bacon/milk mixture.; Stir until well combined.; Serve immediately..
The directions of Carbonara are: Cut bacon into cubes.
column2: Separate eggs.
column4: Slightly beat yolks.
column5: Whisk in cream.
column7: Put bacon and grease into pan and saute until crisp at edges.

column1: The directions of Carbonara are: Boil pot of water with salt to cook pasta.; Meanwhile chop bacon and cook in large frying pan.; Once bacon is lightly crisped, add garlic, onions, and turn to slightly lower heat.; Beat 4 eggs into separate mixing bowl.; Once pasta is finished cooking, add it to pan with bacon/onions/garlic and toss at low heat.; Immediately begin pouring eggs over while tossing, so that pasta cooks the eggs without scrambling them.; Add parsley and continue to toss over low heat for about 5 minutes, then serve..

The directions of Carbonara are: Put a large saucepot of water to boil.; Once boiling, add a liberal amount of salt and pasta. Cook to al dente, about 8 minutes.; Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium heat.; Add olive oil and pancetta. Brown pancetta about 2 minutes.; Add red pepper flakes and garlic and cook 2 to 3 minutes more.; Add wine and stir up all pan drippings.; In separate bowl, beat yolks, then add 1 large ladleful (about 1/2 cup)of the pasta cooking water. This tempers the eggs and keeps them from scrambling when added to pasta.; Drain pasta well and add directly to skillet with pancetta, garlic and oil.; Pour egg mixture over pasta. Toss rapidly to coat the pasta without cooking the egg.; Remove from heat and add a big handful of cheese, lots of pepper and a little salt. Continue to toss and turn pasta until soaks up egg mixture and thickens, 1 to 2 minutes.; Serve with extra Romano..

The directions of Carbonara are: Cook bacon and proscuitto in medium skillet, untill bacon is done.; Stir often.; Remove bacon and proscuitto.; Drain all but 1 teaspoon of drippings.; Cook garlic in drippings 30 seconds over medium heat.; In very large 13- 14 inch nonstick skillet, bring cream to simmer.; Add Fontina, Asiago, and Parmesan cheeses to cream.; Stir occationally with wisk over medium/ low heat, till melted.; Mix slurry- corn starch & cold water.; Add salt, pepper and slurry to cream mixture, heat through stirring.; In medium bowl, beat 1 egg and 1 egg yolk.; Dip out 1/4 cup hot cream mixture, mix this gradually into beaten eggs to temper.; Wisk egg mixture into cream sauce, mixing well.; Heat through.; Add butter, stir till melted.; Add bacon, procuitto and garlic in drippings.; Heat through.; Pour over cooked pasta and garnish with Parmesan cheese..

The directions of Carbonara are: Place the bacon and chopped garlic in a large skillet with the olive oil.; Add teaspoon he hot peppers.; Cook on low heat for 12 to 15 minutes until all fat is rendered and the bacon is browned.; Beat the eggs in a bowl with the cheese.; Cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water for about 12 minutes.; Drain and place in a serving bowl.; Quickly spoon over the bacon mixture.; Toss.; Quickly stir in the eggs and cheese.; Add some salt, lots of pepper and toss well.; Serve immediately..

The directions of Carbonara are: Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.; Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.; Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.; Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper and set everything aside.; Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until al dente (just cooked).; Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.; While the spaghetti is cooking, fry the pancetta with the garlic.; Drop the butter into a large wide frying pan or wok and, as soon as the butter has melted, tip in the pancetta and garlic.; Leave these to cook on a medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring often, until the pancetta is golden and crisp.; The garlic has now imparted its flavour, so take it out with a slotted spoon and discard.; Keep the heat under the pancetta on low.; When the pasta is ready lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta. Don't worry if a little water drops in the pan as well (you want this to happen) and don't throw the rest of the pasta water away yet.; Mix most of the cheese in with the eggs, keeping a small handful back for sprinkling over later.; Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.; Now quickly pour in the eggs and cheese and, using the tongs or a long fork, lift up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn't scramble, and everything is coated.; Add extra pasta cooking water to keep it saucy (several tablespoons should do it).; You don't want it wet, just moist.; Season with a little salt, if needed.; Use a long-pronged fork to twist the pasta on to the serving plate or bowl.; Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.; If the dish does get a little dry before serving, splash in some more hot pasta water and the glossy sauciness will be revived..

The directions of Carbonara are: Saute mushrooms in butter, set aside.; Crush garlic, add to skillet with bacon.; Brown.; Start cooking linguine.; DO NOT brown bacon crisp.; Drain.; Now drain linguine but not wash. Toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil.; Quickly stir together over low heat, bacon with 3 tablespoons drippings, add eggs, stir, add mushrooms.; Stir, add sour cream, stir, add Parmesan cheese and stir.; Toss quickly with linguine and serve.

The directions of Carbonara are: Stir-fry sausage and ham until lightly brown.; Remove from wok.; Have all ingredients ready and measured. Add hot spaghetti to meat with butter and parsley.; Mix well.; At once, pour in eggs and continue to blend quickly, lifting and mixing the pasta to coat well.; Sprinkle in the 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese and a dash of pepper.; Mix again.; Serve and top with additional Parmesan cheese..

The directions of Butterscotch Bars are: Melt butter over low heat.; In a bowl, stir butter and brown sugar until well combined.; Stir in the egg.; Beat in the flour, 1/4 c. at a time.; Stir in the baking powder, salt, vanilla and walnuts, and mix well.; Spread batter evenly in greased 8-inch square pan.; Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes, or until top is dry and tester comes out clean..

The directions of Butterscotch Bars are: Combine butter, sugar and brown sugar.; Beat well.; Add egg yolks and vanilla.; Beat well.; Stir in oats, 1/2 cup of nuts and coconut.; Spread onto lightly greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan.; Bake at 350° for 20 minutes..

The directions of Butterscotch Bars are: Melt butter, peanut butter and chips together.; Add marshmallows, nuts and coconut.; Pour into a 9 x 13 buttered pan.; Refrigerate.; When cool, cut in squares.; Keep refrigerated..

The directions of Butterscotch Bars are: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.; Grease 9x13 pan.; In a microwave safe bowl, combine butter and chips.; Microwave on high for 1 1/2-2 minutes, or until thoroughly melted.; Add graham cracker crumbs, mix well.; Set aside 2/3 cup.; Press the remaining mixture into the pan.; In a separate bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth.; Add milk, egg, and vanilla. Mix until creamy.; Pour over the "crust."; Sprinkle reserved mixture over the top.; Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until golden and slightly bubbly on edges.; Allow to cool, then cut into small squares.; Refrigerate, then serve.; Keep leftovers (as if there could be such a thing) in fridge..

The directions of Butterscotch Bars are: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.; Grease and flour a 9 x 9 x 2 inch pan.; In large bowl, combine cake mix, pudding mix, milk and egg.; Beat on low speed until blended, about 1 minute.; Stir in pecans.; Spread batter in prepared pan and sprinkle butterscorch chips evenly over top.; Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until tester comes out clean..
The directions of Butterscotch Bars are: Cream the oleo and 1 cup brown sugar.
column2: Add 1 beaten egg and mix well.
column4: Spread on jelly roll pan like pie crust.
column5: Beat 2 eggs and pour or brush evenly over crust.
column6: Sprinkle 1 cup brown sugar over entire crust.
column8: Bake at 350° until set and brown..

column1: The directions of Butterscotch Bars are: let ice cream melt at room temperature.; heat oven to 350°; coat a jelly roll pan with spray.; line with foil, extending over the edges and sides; coat foil with spray.; in medium bowl, whisk flour, salt, baking powder, allspice, and nutmeg; beat in melted ice cream, scraping down sides of bowl.; at low speed, beat in flour mixture until smooth.; fold in 1 cup butterscotch chips.; Spread batter in prepared pan; Bake at 350* until dry to touch. (about 25 minutes.).; let cool in pan on rack.; smoothly spread bar with frosting; melt remaining 1/4 cup butterscotch chips with oil in glass bowl, in microwave oven for about 45 seconds on high; stir till smooth.; pipe in lines over frosted bars.lightly drag knife across lines; refrigerate and cut into bars to serve.

The directions of Butterscotch Bars are: Preheat oven to 350°.; Combine sugar and butter in a large bowl.; Stir in vanilla and egg.; Weigh or lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups, level with a knife.; Combine flour, oats, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and baking soda in a bowl.; Add oat mixture to sugar mixture, stir with a fork until combined (mixture will be crumbly).; Place 3 cups oat mixture into the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan coated with cooking spray, press into bottom of pan.; Set aside.; Place sweetened condensed milk, butterscotch morsels, and 1/8 teaspoon salt in a microwave-safe bowl, microwave at HIGH 1 minute or until butterscotch morsels melt, stirring every 20 seconds.; Stir in walnuts.; Scrape mixture into pan, spreading evenly over crust.; Sprinkle evenly with remaining oat mixture, gently pressing into butterscotch mixture.; Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until the topping is golden brown.; Place pan on a cooling rack, run a knife around outside edge.; Cool completely..
The directions of Butterscotch Bars are: Heat sugar and butter until bubbly.
column2: Cool and then mix eggs and extracts.
column4: Mix well and put in well-greased pan.
column5: Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°..

column1: The directions of Butterscotch Bars are: Preheat oven to 350°.; In medium pan, melt morsels and margarine.; Stir in crumbs and nuts.; Press 1/2 mixture on bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch dish.; Beat cream cheese until fluffy.; Add milk, egg and vanilla.; Mix well.; Pour over graham cracker mixture.; Put other 1/2 mixture on top.; Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.; Cool and cut in squares..

The directions of Butterscotch Bars are: Grease and flour pan, about 15 x 10-inch.; Preheat oven to 350°.; Mix sugar and Bisquick mix.; Add beaten eggs, vanilla and nuts.; Bake about 30 to 40 minutes.; Batter will fall just before ready to remove from oven.; Sprinkle with powdered sugar (optional).; Cut in squares.; Very easy to make..

The directions of Apple Crumble Pie are: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.; Arrange apple slices in unbaked pie shell.; Mix 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon, sprinkle over apples.; Mix 1/3 cup sugar with flour, cut in butter until crumbly.; Spoon mixture over apples.; Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until apples are soft and top is lightly browned.; Be sure to check for browness of the crust - you may have to cover with tin foil if it's getting too brown..

The directions of Apple Crumble Pie are: Line 9 inch pie plate.; Arrange apples in pastry, and sprinkle with lemon juice.; Make crumble topping by blending sugar, flour, butter, and cinnamon together until fat is well distributed.; Sprinkle over apples.; Bake at 425°F for 20 minutes.; Reduce heat to 350°F and bake until apples are tender, about 20 minutes..

The directions of Apple Crumble Pie are: Preheat oven to 400°.; On a lightly floured surface, roll pastry dough to a 1/8-in.-thick circle, transfer to a 9-in. pie plate.; Trim pastry to 1/2 in. beyond rim of plate, flute edge.; Refrigerate while preparing topping and filling.; For topping, in a small bowl, mix sugar and flour, cut in butter until crumbly.; For filling, in a large bowl, mix sugar, flour, cinnamon and nutmeg.; Add apples and toss to coat.; Transfer to pastry-lined pie plate.; Sprinkle with topping.; Bake 10 minutes.; Reduce oven setting to 375°.; Bake 40-45 minutes or until topping is browned and apples are tender.; Cover edge loosely with foil during the last 15 minutes if needed to prevent overbrowning.; Cool on a wire rack..

The directions of Apple Crumble Pie are: Combine 1/2 cup of the sugar, the 2 tablespoons flour and the lemon peel.; Sprinkle apple slices with lemon juice.; Add sugar mixture and toss to coat.; Fill a pastry-lined 9-inch pie plate with apple mixture..

The directions of Apple Crumble Pie are: Preheat oven to 375°F.; In a bowl, combine apple chunks, cinnamon, vanilla and coconut sugar.; Toss to evenly coat apples in mixture.; Pour mixture into pre-made pie crust shell. (Whole Foods carries gluten-free, vegan options).; In the same bowl, add crumb-topping ingredients, using your hands or a spatula to combine and clump together.; Pour topping over apples.; Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.; Take off aluminum foil and bake for another 15 minutes..

The directions of Chicken Bake are: Preheat oven to 450°.; Mix broccoli, soup, chicken and onion powder into ungreased baking dish, 13 x 9 x 2-inch.; Mix remaining ingredients and milk.; Pour evenly over soup mixture, sprinkle with parsley.; Bake 30 minutes until golden brown.; Let stand 5 minutes.; Makes 8 to 10 servings..

The directions of Chicken Bake are: Cook lasagna according to the directions on the box.; Blend cottage cheese and American cheese.; For the sauce, cook onion and green pepper in butter.; Stir in cream of chicken soup, milk, mushrooms, pimento, basil and chicken.; Lightly grease 9x13 pan.; Line pan with noodles.; Use 1/2 of the chicken mixture for the next layer then all of the cheese mixture and end with the rest of the chicken mixture.; Top with 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese.; Bake at 350 for 45 minutes..

The directions of Chicken Bake are: Place chicken in baking dish.; Layer cheese on top of chicken. Mix in a bowl the soups, gravy, salt and pepper.; Pour over chicken and cheese.; Spread stuffing mix over top.; Pour melted butter over stuffing mix.; To double servings, add only more chicken, Swiss cheese and 1 can chicken broth..

The directions of Chicken Bake are: In a casserole dish, mix up the minced artichokes, mayo, red pepper flakes and parmesan.; Melt the butter and fry the garlic.; Mix garlic in with the mayo mixture.; Place chicken in the casserole.; Spoon the mayo over top of the chicken.; Mince the bacon and mushrooms.; Place over the chicken.; Cook @ 400 for 30-40 minute (till the bacon browns and chicken is cooked through..

The directions of Chicken Bake are: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.; Prepare noodles according to package directions.; In a medium saucepan combine canned soup, milk and bouillon.; Heat just to boiling.; Remove from heat.; Add can of peas to soup mixture.; In a large bowl combine drained noodles, pea soup mixture and chicken.; Stir until evenly mixed.; Pour into 3 quart baking dish.; Sprinkle with shredded cheese.; Cover and bake at 350 degree for 20 - 30 minutes..

The directions of Chicken Bake are: Mix oleo, soups and rice together.; Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Lay chicken breasts on top.; Brush chicken with melted oleo and sprinkle with some paprika.; Bake at 275° for 2 1/2 hours..
The directions of Chicken Bake are: Mix all ingredients together.
column2: Put into a glass baking dish. (We use a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.)
column3: Cover with a sprinkling of cashews.
column4: Bake at 350° for 45 minutes..

column1: The directions of Chicken Bake are: Cook chicken until done, then cool and cut into small pieces. Add this to rice, celery, soup, mayonnaise and chestnuts.; Pour into baking dish.; Top with corn flakes mixed with butter.; Bake 30 minutes at 350°..

The directions of Chicken Bake are: Cook onions and peppers in butter until tender.; Stir in soup mushrooms and milk.; Layer half the noodles in 9x13 pan, sprayed with Pam, then layer mixture. Layer cottage cheese, chicken and cheese.; Repeat layers.; Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until cheese has melted and browned..

The directions of Chicken Bake are: Add bouillon, rice, carrots and potatoes to boiling water and salt, cover and simmer for 15 minutes.; Add mushroom soup (diluted).; Stir together thoroughly.; Pour into baking dish and top with chicken chunks and pepper.; Bake in 375° oven for 15 minutes, then stir and bake for 10 minutes longer or until all liquid is absorbed.; Strips of cheese may be placed on top of hot rice..

The directions of Chicken Bake are: Preheat oven to 350°.; Put all dry ingredients in large Ziploc bag.; Cut up fryer.; Shake chicken in bag to coat with seasonings. Arrange in baking pan (13 x 9-inch).; Pour water in bottom. Sprinkle with melted butter and oil.; Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes.; Pour wine over chicken.; Lower heat to 325° and cover, bake 15 minutes.; Remove foil and bake 10 more minutes..

The directions of Chicken Bake are: Prepare macaroni according to package directions.; Drain. Saute pepper and onions in margarine, add mushrooms and cook until onions and pepper are tender.; Combine macaroni, cheese, onion mixture, soup, milk and pepper.; Mix well.; Stir in chicken and olives.; Pour in baking dish.; Cover with foil.; Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.; Remove from oven and top with almonds.; Bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes..

The directions of Chicken Bake are: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.; Lightly grease a 9x13 pan or 3 quart casserole dish.; In saucepan combine carrots, onion, celery and chicken broth, simmer 20 minutes.; In prepared pan mix soup, sour cream, chicken, mushrooms, salt and pepper.; Add the simmered vegetables mixing well.; For topping combine Pancake mix, eggs, milk and peppers mixing well.; Add 1 cup cheese blending well.; Drop by round tablespoon on top of casserole.; Bake 40-45 minutes.; Sprinkle remaining cheese on top and return to oven till melted..
The directions of Chicken Bake are: Place chicken in large baking dish.
column2: Sprinkle with rice.
column4: Pour over chicken.
column5: Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour..

column1: The directions of Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups are: Mix cream cheese, garlic salt, Worcestershire sauce and chopped nuts together.; Spread mixture on ham slices and roll up longways.; Refrigerate until firm.; Remove and slice in 1-inch slices..

The directions of Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups are: In small bowl combine cheeses and margarine until well blended.; Spread 1/4 of mixture on each ham slice.; Roll up from short side, chill several hours..

The directions of Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups are: Mix baking mix and water until dough forms.; Smooth into ball on cloth covered surface dusted with baking mix.; Knead 15 times. Roll into rectangle, 15 x 9-inches.; Spread with mustard.; Top with remaining ingredients.; Roll up tightly, beginning at 15-inch side.; Pinch edge into roll (moisten if necessary).; Wrap and refrigerate at least 30 minutes but no longer than 24 hours.; Heat oven to 400°.; Cut into 12 slices.; Place on greased and floured cookie sheet (replace filling if necessary)..
The directions of Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups are: Mix together first three ingredients.
column2: Spread on each ham slice and roll up.
column4: Cut rolls into smaller rolls..

column1: The directions of Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups are: Combine cheese and oleo, blend well.; Spread on ham.; Roll up and chill several hours.; Slice in about 3 1/2 dozen slices. Place on round Ritz crackers.; Let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes before serving..
The directions of Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups are: Mix cheese, sugar and pineapple.; Spread on ham, roll up. Cover with wax paper and chill.; Slice and serve..

The directions of Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups are: Mix cream cheese, onion soup mix and ripe olives well.; Spread a thin layer of this mixture onto a slice of ham.; Top with a slice of cheese and spread a thin layer of mixture on top.; Roll lengthwise.; Wrap tightly in foil and refrigerate several hours or overnight.; Continue process with remaining ham, cheese and mixture.; Slice thinly and place on round rye crackers.; Serve..

The directions of Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups are: Combine cream cheese, mustard, olives, onions, mayonnaise, horseradish spread, paprika, Worcestershire sauce and Tabasco, mix well.; Spread on slice of ham.; Place a square of cheese on top of cheese mixture.; Roll up.; Refrigerate overnight.; Cut rye bread with small round cutter.; Slice ham into 10 slices.; Place on top of bread.; Freezes well..

The directions of Tortilla Roll-Ups are: Mix together cream cheese, onion, hot sauce, sour cream and chopped chilies.; Spread thinly on tortillas, lay ham on top of spread.; Roll tortillas up tightly.; Chill.; When ready to serve, cut into bite size pinwheels..

The directions of Tortilla Roll-Ups are: Mix cream cheese, ranch dressing and onions and spread on tortillas.; Layer with red pepper, celery and olives.; Roll tortillas up tight, wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.; Slice and serve..

The directions of Tortilla Roll-Ups are: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.; Mix all ingredients (excluding tortillas and mozzarella cheese) in a large bowl.; Divide, saving half to spread over top of casserole.; Fill each torilla with mixture and roll into a burrito shape.; Then place in a 9x13 lightly greased baking pan.; When your pan is full, pour reserved mixture over top.; Top casserole with mozzeralla cheese.; Bake until bubbly, about 25 minutes..
The directions of Tortilla Roll-Ups are: Mix first five ingredients well.
column2: Spread mixture onto flour tortillas and roll them up.
column4: Cut into slices like cinnamon rolls.
column5: Great appetizers or party snacks..

column1: The directions of Tortilla Roll-Ups are: Mix all together.
column2: Spread on tortillas.
column3: Roll up tortilla and slice about 1-inch thick.
column4: Serve with hot sauce or salsa..

column1: The directions of Tortilla Roll-Ups are: Combine sour cream, cream cheese, green chilies, lemon juice and cumin.; Spread mixture over each tortilla and refrigerate several hours or overnight.; Slice into 3/4-inch pieces and serve with picante sauce..
The directions of Tortilla Roll-Ups are: Mix all ingredients together and chill for at least one hour.
column2: Spread on flat flour tortilla and tightly roll.
column4: Serve with salsa..

column1: The directions of Tortilla Roll-Ups are: Soften cream cheese and mix in the Ranch dip packet.; Chop bell pepper.; Chop cilantro.; Spread cream cheese mix on tortilla. Sprinkle chopped bell pepper over cream cheese.; Sprinkle green chilies over.; Sprinkle grated cheese and cilantro.; Roll tortilla and secure with a toothpick.; Repeat until all ingredients are used, usually makes 4 Roll-Ups.; Wrap each in aluminum foil and chill at least 3 hours.; Slice before serving.; Serve with salsa..

The directions of Tortilla Roll-Ups are: Brown sausage and drain off fat.; Stir in cottage cheese and flour.; Add oregano, basil and garlic powder to the spaghetti sauce.; Stir in 1/2 cup of the spaghetti sauce into the sausage mixture.; Spoon about 1/3 cup meat mixture onto each tortilla, roll up jelly roll style.; Place tortillas, seam side down, in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.; Pour remaining spaghetti sauce over tortillas. Bake covered at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.; Uncover, sprinkle Mozzarella cheese atop.; Bake 3 minutes or until cheese melts..
The directions of Tortilla Roll-Ups are: Mix cream cheese and horseradish together.
column2: Spread evenly over tortilla.
column3: Put 1 slice of beef on tortilla.
column4: Add onion and tomatoes.
column5: Roll tightly and cut into 1-inch pieces.
column6: Serve with additional horseradish sauce or salsa to dip in..

column1: The directions of Seafood Soup are: Combine onions and garlic and cook, covered, over low heat until soft, stirring frequently so they don't scorch.; Add parsley, bell pepper, tomato sauce, wine, water, thyme, rosemary, salt, pepper and bay leaf and simmer, covered 1 hour.; Add crab or white fish, shrimp, scallops or clams and cook, covered, for 8 to 10 minutes or until scallops or clam shells open.; Discard any shells that do not open..

The directions of Seafood Soup are: Shell and devein shrimp, placing only shells in large saucepan.; Rinse shrimp, drain.; Pour 3 cups water over shells, bring to boil.; Reduce heat, simmer, uncovered, 20 to 25 minutes, or until liquid is reduced in half.; Strain liquid, discard shells and return stock to saucepan.; Stir in tomatoes, corn, less sodium soy sauce, sherry and lemon juice, cover and bring to boil.; Reduce heat, simmer 5 minutes.; Add shrimp and scallops, simmer, uncovered, 2 minutes, stirring occasionally to break up tomatoes.; Blend cornstarch and 1 Tsbp. water, stir into soup.; Bring to boil, cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.; Stir in green onion and pepper, serve immediately..
The directions of Tortilla Roll-Ups are: Mix first five ingredients well.
column2: Spread mixture onto flour tortillas and roll them up.
column4: Cut into slices like cinnamon rolls.
column5: Great appetizers or party snacks..

column1: The directions of Trout Amandine are: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat.; Saute almonds in butter until golden.; Add 1/4 teaspoons salt and lemon juice, remove from heat. Set aside.; Combine remaining 1/2 teaspoons salt, flour, pepper, and thyme.; Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.; Dip fillets in milk, dredge in flour mixture.; Fry fillets, 2 at a time until browned on both sides, drain in paper towels.; Remove to a serving dish, drizzle with almond butter sauce, and sprinkle with parsley..

The directions of Corn Pancakes are: Set aside 1/2 cup corn kernels.; In a food processor or blender, blend remaining 1 cup corn with 1 egg white, tofu, flour, parsley, baking power, salt and pepper until smooth, stopping once to scrape down the sides of the container.; Transfer mixture to a bowl and stir in reserved whole corn.; In another bowl, beat the remaining 2 egg whites to soft, moist peaks that droop slightly when the beater is lifted (just a couple of minutes).; Scoop the egg whites onto the corn batter and fold them in gently with a rubber spatula.; Preheat oven to low.; Spray a nonstick skillet lightly with a nonstick spray and place over moderate heat.; When the skillet is hot enough to make the batter sizzle, make pancakes, using 1/4 cup batter per cake.; Cook until browned on the bottom, 2-3 minutes, then turn and cook until cakes are golden brown on the other side, about 2 more minutes.; Transfer to a platter and keep warm in oven.; Continue until all batter is used..

The directions of Corn Pancakes are: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees.; In a bowl, combine the cornmeal, flour, baking soda, salt, sugar and butter.; Blend together with your fingertips or a pastry blender until the consistency of a coarse meal.; Pour in the buttermilk and stir just until the dry ingredients are evenly moistened.; Add just enough milk to form a thin pancake batter, stirring gently to combine.; Heat the griddle or large castiron skillet over medium heat and lightly coat with butter or oil.; Ladle on about 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake and cook until bubbles form on the surface of each pancake and the bottom is golden brown.; Flip and cook on the second side until golden, about 1 minute.; Transfer to a paper towellined baking sheet and keep warm in the oven while you cook the rest of the pancakes.; Served hot, topped with Maple Fruit Compote..

The directions of Apple Crumble Pie are: Bake pie crust at 375 for 5 minutes, cool.; Pour apple pie filling into shell.; Mix flour,sugar and cinnamon in small bowl.; Add in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs, stir in pecans.; Sprinkle over pie filling.; Bake at 375 for 25-30 minutes, or until topping is golden brown.; Serve sprinkled with powdered sugar..

The directions of Apple Crumble Pie are: Preheat oven to 400°F. For the pastry, combine flour and butter in a large bowl. Rub in well using fingertips until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Stir in the sugar, then add enough water to bring the dough together. Knead into a ball, wrap in cling wrap and chill 20 mins. Roll out between 2 sheets of parchment paper until 1 inch thick. Ease into a 10 inch pie pan. Trim the excess pastry and chill 10 mins.; Place pan on a baking sheet. Line pastry with parchment paper and fill with dry beans. Bake 10 mins, then remove paper and beans and bake 5 more mins. Cool on a wire rack. Reduce oven temperature to 350°F.; To make the crumble topping, rub the butter and flour together with your fingers until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Stir in the spices, oats, nuts and sugar. Add 3 tbsp cold water and mix gently.; To assemble, fill pastry with the stewed apples, leaving a bit of space at the top Spoon on the crumble topping, then place the dish on a baking sheet and bake 30 mins, or until the crumble is browned. Serve warm or hot with whipped cream or ice cream, if using..

The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.; In a medium bowl combine crushed saltines,parmesan cheese,Italian seasoning and garlic powder,mix well together.; Dip chops in melted butter and then dredge in cracker mixture coating all sides; Place chops in a 9x13 inch baking dish.; Bake at 425 degrees for 30-40 min or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees..

The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: Melt shortening in large skillet.; Add pork chops and brown quickly on both sides.; Remove chops and drain all but 2 tablespoons fat.; Cook onion and green pepper until soft.; Ad tomato sauce, water, sugar and seasonings.; Heat to boiling and cook for 5 minutes.; Arrange potatoes in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.; Place pork chops on top of potatoes and pour sauce over all.; Cover casserole with lid or foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.; Remove cover and sprinkle with cheese.; Bake 15 minutes more..

The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: Sprinkle chops with pepper.; Coat a large skillet with cooking spray.; Place chops in skillet and brown on both sides.; Transfer to a 2-qt baking dish.; Cover the chops with mushrooms and set aside.; Saute the onions, garlic, and green pepper over medium heat until tender.; Stir in the tomato sauce, sherry, lemon juice, oregano, and basil.; Let simmer, uncovered, for 10 to 15 minutes.; Pour tomato mixture over pork chops.; Cover and bake at 350 for 40 minutes..

The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: In a large skillet, brown pork chops in batches on both sides in oil, remove from skillet.; Add the onion, mushrooms and garlic, saute for 5 minutes or until tender.; Stir in the tomatoes, salt, oregano, basil and pepper.; Return pork chops to skillet, arrange green pepper between the chops.; Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until meat is tender..

The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: Salt and pepper both sides of the pork chops, set aside.; Add the tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, garlic, onion, basil, and oregano to your crock pot or slow cooker.; In a pan heat up a little oil over medium high heat, sear each pork chop until brown on each side (30 seconds to a minute).; After each pork chop has been seared place it in the slow cooker, submerging it as much as possible in the tomato mixture.; Over medium-high heat add the red wine to the pan you seared the pork chops in to deglaze the pan.; Scrape up any brown bits that are stuck to the pan.; As soon as the pan is deglazed (about 30 seconds) dump the red wine liquid into the crock pot.; Cover crock pot and set on low for 8 hours (if some of your pork chops arent submerged in the tomato sauce you might want to rotate them every 2 hours.); After 8 hours, boil some water and prepare pasta according to packaging instructions.; Then drain.; You may want to salt and pepper the tomato sauce at this point but I find the pork flavors it enough that its not necessary.; Place pork chops on top of pasta (it should be so tender it falls off the bone) and spoon tomato sauce over the whole thing.; Devour pasta and sop up any of the wonderful tomato sauce with a piece of bread..

The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: In large skillet, brown pork chops, adding salt and pepper to taste.; Arrange in a casserole dish.; Slice peppers and onions. Put on top of pork chops.; Pour large can of tomato sauce over everything.; Sprinkle with oregano.; Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done..

The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.; Heat shortening in large skillet, add pork chops and brown quickly on both sides.; Remove chops and drain off all but 2 tablespoons fat.; Cook onion and green pepper in remaining fat for about 3 minutes or until onion is soft.; Add tomato sauce, water, sugar and seasonings.; Heat to boiling and cook for about 5 minutes.; Arrange potatoes in a large shallow baking dish or casserole.; Place pork chops on top of potatoes and pour sauce over all.; Cover casserole with lid or foil.; Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.; Remove cover and sprinkle with grated romano cheese, returning to oven and baking 15 minutes longer..

The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: Season chops with garlic salt, thyme and oregano.; Place in shallow dish.; Mix onion, pepper and mushrooms in tomatoes and pour over pork chops.; Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Serve with rice..
The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: Coat pork chops with Bisquick mix.
column2: Dip coated chops into Italian dressing.
column4: Heat oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
column5: Cook pork about 5 minutes or until golden brown.

column1: The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: 1.; In a shallow pan, combine the eggs, milk, dijon, and salt and pepper.; In another pan, add the flour, lemon zest, and a little more salt and pepper.; In another pan, pour in the bread crumbs.; 2.; First, place the pork chops in the flour mixture and cover completely.; Next, drop the pork chop in the egg mixture and then into the bread crumbs.; 3.; Preheat the oven to 425F.; Spray a broiler pan with non stick spray.; Place the pork chops on the pan and cook for about 25 minutes, flipping half way through.; Then, switch the oven to broil and cook the pork chops until they are golden brown, about 5 minutes longer..

The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: Cook celery until almost tender in 1 tablespoon of margarine.; strain and remove.; add chops and brown on one side -- season with spices and turn over season with remaining spices.; brown other side.; add apples , and partially cooked celery cover and cook on medium heat until chops are done and apples are tender but not mushy..
The directions of Italian Pork Chops are: Chop garlic fine.
column2: Add salt and basil and mash into paste.
column3: Rub pork chops with the paste and leave for 1 hour..

column1: The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Combine the cream cheese, butter and flour and blend completely.; Chill.; Roll out the dough, half at a time, to about 1/4 inch thick.; Cut into small rounds or other dainty shapes.; Make a small depression in the center of each cookie and place 1/2 teaspoons preserves.; Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes.; Cool, and dust with confectioners' sugar if desired.; Note: I love using Knott's Berry Farm Raspberry preserves..

The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.; When removed from oven, loosen each cookie; cool on pan about 5 minutes.; Remove to paper towel and cool completely before storing in airtight container..
The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Cream margarine and cream cheese.
column2: Blend in egg and vanilla.
column3: Add cake mix 1/3 at a time and mix well.
column4: Cover and chill 30 minutes..

column1: The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Cream butter and cheese.; Blend in egg and vanilla. Add dry cake mix, 1/3 at a time, mixing well after each addition.; (If mixer is used, add last 1/3 of cake mix by hand.); Cover and chill 30 minutes..
The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Mix together the first 4 ingredients.
column2: Take out about 1 cup of mixture.
column3: Spread remaining ingredients in an 8 x 12 x 2-inch pan to make a crumb crust.
column4: Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes..

column1: The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Bring butter and cream cheese to room temperature.; Cream butter and cream cheese together, slowly adding sugar.; Add flour, baking powder and vanilla until blended.; Add nuts.; Drop by teaspoon onto a cookie sheet.; Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.; Will brown lightly around bottom and lightly on top.; Then they are firmly set..
The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Have cream cheese and oleo at room temperature.
column2: Mix other ingredients.
column4: Roll out in balls and place on greased cookie sheets.
column5: Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes or until done..

column1: The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Mix all ingredients until well blended.
column2: Roll into 1 inch balls.
column3: Put 1/2 cherry on top and bake for 10 minutes at 350°. Makes 5 dozen..

column1: The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Cream the cream cheese and butter.; Gradually add sugar, nuts and flour.; Drop on ungreased cookie sheets and flatten dough with wet finger until wafer-thin.; Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.; Makes 3 dozen..

The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Cream together butter and cream cheese, add sugar. Beat egg yolk.; Add flour and vanilla.; Chill 1 hour.; Shape into 1-inch balls.; Put on greased cookie sheet.; Press pecan into cookie.; Bake at 350° for 12 minutes..

The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Cream shortening and cheese together, add sugar and continue creaming.; Beat egg yolk, vanilla, and orange rind together.; Sift flour, salt and cinnamon together.; Mix all ingredients together.; Place cookies on a cookie sheet and bake 12-15 minutes at 350 degrees..
The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Cream the oleo and cheese. Slowly add sugar and beat until fluffy. Beat in egg yolk.
column2: Add flour and vanilla.
column4: Shape in small balls.
column5: Press cherry lightly on dough to flatten. Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes..

column1: The directions of Cream Cheese Cookies are: Beat cream cheese and butter until light and fluffy.; Mix in about 1/2 of the cake mix, the egg and vanilla until smooth.; Stir in remaining cake mix and nuts.; Drop dough by teaspoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet.; Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.; Cool slightly, remove from cookie sheet.; Makes about 5 dozen cookies..

The directions of Stuffed Pizza are: Heat oven to 450°.; Grease rectangular baking dish, 13 x 9 x 2-inch.; Cook and stir sausage and ground beef until brown, drain and set aside.; Mix baking mix and water until dough forms.; Divide in two parts, one part slightly larger.; Roll larger portion of dough into rectangle, 16 x 14-inches.; Place in dish, press on bottom and up sides.; Sprinkle with 1 cup of cheese, cover with 3/4 cup pizza sauce and meat mixture and other toppings.; Cover with 1 1/2 cups of the cheese.; Roll remaining dough into rectangle, 13 x 9-inches.; Place over cheese in dish.; Press bottom and top crust edges together to seal.; Make small slits in top crust.; Spread crust with remaining pizza sauce and cheese.; Bake 22 to 25 minutes or until crust is golden.; Makes 8 to 10 servings..

The directions of Stuffed Pizza are: For crust, dissolve sugar and yeast in water, set aside.; In a large bowl, combine flour and salt.; Stir in yeast mixture and oil, mix until dough forms a ball.; Knead on a lightly floured surface 6-8 minutes or until smooth.; Place in a greased bowl, turning once to grease top.; Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour.; Meanwhile, for filling, cook beef and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink, drain and cool.; Stir in the olives, mushrooms, spinach and cheese, set aside.; Punch dough down.; Divide into two pieces, one slightly larger than the other.; Roll out the larger piece into a 15-in. circle.; Press onto the bottom and up the sides of a greased 12-in. deep-dish pizza pan.; Cover with meat mixture.; Roll out remaining dough into a 12-in. circle, place over meat mixture.; Crimp edges of crusts together to seal, gently press top crust onto meat filling. Cut a 1-in. slit in center of crust.; Spread spaghetti sauce over top crust.; Bake at 475° for 35-40 minutes or until lightly browned..

The directions of Stuffed Pizza are: Thaw out in bread wrapper 3 loaves of frozen dough (Dakato Brand is best).; Let rise until double in size, about 8 hours. Grease 2 pizza pans (13 x 18-inch) with Crisco.; Cut dough in half.; Press 1/2 dough into each pan.; (Make sure dough doesn't shrink.); Cover with towel and let rise for 1 hour..

The directions of Stuffed Pizza are: Lightly grease a 13 x 9-inch pan.; Brown sausage and hamburger and drain.; Mix Bisquick and water, divide dough in 2 parts, one larger.; Roll larger section into rectangle and place in pan.; Sprinkle 1 cup of cheese, 3/4 cup pizza sauce, meat and other toppings.; Cover with 1 1/2 cups of cheese.; Roll remaining dough and place on top of mixture.; Press edges together and make slits in top.; Spread with remaining pizza sauce and cheese.; Bake at 450° for 20 to 25 minutes..

The directions of Stuffed Pizza are: Mix together Ricotta cheese, broccoli and eggs.; Spread on bottom crust.; Spoon chopped tomatoes on bottom crust.; Top with Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese.; Top with second crust. Bake at 450° for 25 minutes.; One-half cup of pizza sauce last few minutes of baking..
The directions of Stuffed Pizza are: Cook sausage and ground beef until brown.
column2: Drain grease.
column3: Mix Bisquick and cold water until forms a ball.
column4: Divide dough into 2 parts..

column1: The directions of Stuffed Pizza are: Heat oven to 450 degrees.; Grease rectangular baking dish, 13 by 9 by 2 inches.; Cook sausage and ground beef in 10-inch skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until brown.; Drain, set aside.; Stir Bisquick and water in large bowl until dough forms.; Divide dough into 2 parts, 1 part slightly larger.; Roll larger part dough into rectangle, 16 by 14 inches, on surface dusted with Bisquick.; Fold crosswise into thirds.; Place in center of baking dish, unfold.; Press on bottom and up sides of dish.; Sprinkle with 1 cup of the cheese, top with 3/4 cup of the pizza sauce, the meat mixture, mushrooms and bell pepper, pizza toppings and 1 1/2 cups of the cheese.; Roll remaining part dough into rectangle, 13 by 9 inches.; Fold crosswise into thirds.; Place on cheese in center of baking dish, unfold.; Press bottom and top crust edges together to seal.; Make small slits in top crust.; Spread remaining pizza sauce over crust, sprinkle with remaining cheese.; Bake uncovered 22 to 25 minutes or until edges of crust are golden brown..

The directions of Stuffed Pizza are: Heat oven to 350.; Spray a 12-inch pizza pan with nonstick cooking spray.; In a medium-size bowl, combine chili and green chilies.; Slightly overlap crescent dough triangles, smallest point in center, around 12-inch pizza pan.; Position each triangle so outside edge is slightly hanging over the edge of the pan.; Spoon chili mixture in a ring on dough, halfway between center and edge of pan, bring top half of each triangle over chili and seal with other dough in center of circle.; Sprinkle with cheese.; Bake for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown.; Allow to cool slightly.; To serve, fill center of pizza with toppings and cut into 8 slices..

The directions of Stuffed Pizza are: Spread 1 ball of dough on round pizza pan.; Fry sausage, drain. Add mushrooms, onion, garlic, sauce and pepperoni.; Warm through. Place on pizza shell.; Top with cheeses.; Form 1/2 ball of dough and place on top.; Turn edges under.; Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.; When brown on top, remove from pan and bake on rack to brown bottom (5 to 10 minutes).; If your dough has holes on bottom this will create a mess.; Makes 8 big servings..

The directions of Stuffed Pizza are: If using the breadmaker, place the wet ingredients in the pan, followed by the dry ingredients, set to dough cycle and allow to run.; If not using the breadmaker, dissolve the yeast in lukewarm water.; Add shortening, sugar and salt.; Stir in 2 cups flour.; Add enough more flour to form a soft dough.; Turn dough onto lightly floured board, knead until smooth and elastic, working in more flour as needed.; Divide dough into thirds, cover and set one third to the side.; Roll the remaining two-thirds into a 14 inch circle.; Brush a 12 inch, two-inch deep pizza pan lightly with oil.; Press dough evenly over bottom and up the sides of the pan.; Remove the sausage from the casing and crumble into the crust (it doesn't need precooking).; Saute onion and green pepper in 1 tablespoon of oil until tender.; Stir in salt, sprinkle vegetables over the sausage.; Top with mozzarella cheese and mushrooms.; For the topping, saute tomatoes and spices for ten minutes, breaking up the tomatoes with a fork.; Roll out remaining one-third of dough into a 12 inch circle.; Set over the filling in the pan.; Crimp edges of top and bottom crust together to seal well.; Prick the top crust all over with a fork.; Spread tomato sauce over the top and sprinkle with parmesan.; Bake at 425F for 45 minutes, or until crust is golden.; Let stand ten minutes before serving..

The directions of Easy Enchiladas are: Brown meat and onions.; Drain.; Heat together enchilada sauce, sour cream and soup.; Fill tortillas with meat, cheese and sauce, saving a portion of the sauce mixture and cheese for topping.; Roll up tortillas.; Place in 9x13x2 inch pan or dish. Pour remaining sauce over enchiladas and sprinkle with cheese.; Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes..

The directions of Easy Enchiladas are: Heat sauce in a 10-inch skillet.; Dip a tortilla in the sauce to make it easy to work with.; Place the tortilla on your Dutch oven lid or plate and add some meat, onion and cheese.; Roll up and gently place in a Dutch oven or pan.; When pan is full, pour the rest of the sauce over the enchiladas and sprinkle a little cheese on top.; Heat until sauce bubbles or cheese melts.; Serve warm and top with some sour cream..

The directions of Easy Enchiladas are: Fry tortillas in oil until soft.; Stack, set aside.; Brown meat and add tomato sauce, chili and garlic powder to taste.; Simmer. Roll meat mixture in tortilla (you can secure with toothpick).; Place stuffed tortillas in flat Pyrex dish.; Cover with tomato soup mixed with chili and grated cheese.; Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.; Sprinkle with sliced green peppers..

The directions of Easy Enchiladas are: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).; Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish, and pour the salsa into the bottom of the dish.; Set aside.; Cook and stir the ground beef in a skillet over medium heat for about 10 minutes, until meat is browned and crumbly.; Drain the grease from the beef, and add the salsa con queso to the skillet, stirring to mix well.; Place about 2 tablespoons of the beef mixture down the center of each tortilla, roll the tortillas, and place them seam side down on top of the salsa in the baking dish.; Sprinkle the shredded cheese on top of the enchiladas.; Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until the cheese is browned and the enchiladas are hot and bubbling..
