The directions of Mediterranean Wrap are: Place the onion, zucchini, eggplant, mushrooms, and bell pepper into a large container with a tight fitting lid.; Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables and season with salt and pepper.; Close the lid and shake to coat.; Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.; Place the seasoned vegetables on the preheated pan, stir and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.; Spread each tortilla with 1 tablespoon goat cheese and 1 tablespoon pesto.; Divide the sliced avocado among the tortillas and top with the mixed veggies.; Fold in the bottom of each tortilla and roll each up into a snug wrap..

The directions of Mediterranean Wrap are: Preheat the broiler.; Discard the outermost slices of zucchini and brush the rest with oil, dust with salt and pepper.; Place on a baking sheet and broil about 3 inches from heat for 5 minutes on each side, or until tender and slightly browned.; Spread 1/4 cup hummus on each wrap and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon pine nuts.; Top with a few slices of tomato and zucchini, 1/2 cup spinach, a few sliced onions, and 1 tablespoon mint.; Roll up and cut in half on a diagonal..

The directions of Mediterranean Wrap are: Spread cream cheese over 1 side of wrap. Top with chopped spinach and remaining ingredients.; Roll up wrap tightly. Cut diagonally in half.; Note: For testing purposes only, we used Brianna's Blush Wine Vinaigrette..

The directions of Mediterranean Wrap are: Steam green beans 8 minutes in steamer until crisp-tender.; Plunge into cold water, then drain, and pat dry.; Spread each tortilla with 2 Tbs.; goat cheese and 2 Tbs.; artichoke spread, leaving 1 inch edge on sides.; Top with one-quarter tomato slices.; Place 6 or 7 green beans in a tight bunch on top third of tortilla, then tightly roll tortilla like a burrito, folding in sides.; Wrap in wax paper or foil until ready to serve..

The directions of Salmon Croquettes are: Cook potatoes in boiling water to cover in medium-size saucepan for 8 to 10 minutes or until fork-tender.; Drain. Transfer potatoes to medium-size bowl.; Mash until smooth.; Add salmon, green onion, egg, parsley and ginger.; Stir to mix well. Shape salmon mixture into 8 equal size oval logs, using about 1/3 cup for each.; Spoon flour onto wax paper. Roll croquettes in flour to coat.; Pour oil into medium-size skillet to depth of 1/2-inch.; Heat oil to hot, but not smoking.; Working in batches, fry croquettes, turning occasionally, until golden and crusty on all sides..
The directions of Salmon Croquettes are: Combine all ingredients.
column2: Shape into patties and fry in butter or margarine.
column3: May be made ahead and frozen until needed..

column1: The directions of Salmon Croquettes are: Brown onion in butter until clear.; Add enough flour to thicken.; Stir in all of the salmon juice and milk.; When this thickens, add mashed salmon and lemon juice.; Mix well.; Chill for 3 to 5 hours.; When thoroughly chilled, shape into croquettes. Dip in beaten egg and roll in crumbs.; Fry in hot oil until tender.; Serves 4..

The directions of Salmon Croquettes are: Make cream sauce with oleo, flour, pepper, broth, and milk. Blend in salmon, onion, and parsley.; Refrigerate 1 hour.; Shape into eight cones or cylinders.; Roll in crumbs.; Dip in egg substitute.; Roll again in crumbs.; Refrigerate another hour.; Fry in deep hot 374° corn oil until brown.; Draining on paper towels. Serve with sauce made with skin milk, such as curry or mushroom..
The directions of Salmon Croquettes are: Mix all ingredients together except butter.
column2: Make into patties and then brush with butter.
column4: Broil 3 inches from flame with oven door open for about 6 to 10 minutes. Watch carefully for they brown quickly.
column5: It is not necessary to turn.
column6: Yields 6 depending on size of patties..

column1: The directions of Salmon Croquettes are: Mix salmon together with eggs, crackers, onion, salt and pepper.; Shape into small, thin patties.; Fry in hot bacon grease over medium heat until golden brown on both sides.; Oil can be mixed with the bacon grease for frying.; Drain on paper towels and serve while hot!.

The directions of Salmon Croquettes are: Drain about half of the liquid from salmon, then flake salmon.; Combine bread crumbs, onion, seasonings, and soup.; Stir in salmon, mix well.; Chill for 2 hours.; Shape mixture into croquettes or patties.; Roll in cornmeal.; Fry in hot deep oil (vegatable oil) until browned..
The directions of Pork Roast are: Brown roast on top of stove.
column2: Add everything else except carrots.
column3: Place in 325 degree (175 C.) oven for 3 hours.
column4: Add carrots and put back in oven for approximately 1 additional hour.
column5: Remove from pan and use juice for gravy..

column1: The directions of Pork Roast are: Have meat market person loosen backbone of pork loin.; Place roast, fat side up, on rack in open roasting pan in center of oven. Roast in 325° oven for 2 to 3 hours or until meat thermometer which has been inserted in center of roast's thickest part (not touching bone) registers 170°.; In saucepan, combine applesauce, molasses, ginger and garlic over medium heat.; Brush pork every 10 minutes the last 30 minutes of cooking.; Serve pork with remaining applesauce.; The size of the roast will determine length of cooking time..

The directions of Pork Roast are: Place pork in self-sealing bag.; In blender, pulse parsley, onion and garlic until minced.; Add remaining ingredients, process to blend.; Add mixture to bag, seal and toss to coat pork.; Refrigerate overnight.; Preheat oven to 500 degrees.; Remove pork from bag, discard marinade.; Place pork on wire rack inside roasting pan, bake 15 minutes.; Lower oven temperature to 325 degrees, continue cooking until internal meat temperature reaches 155 degrees, about 1 hour.; Let stand 10 minutes before slicing..

The directions of Pork Roast are: Rub brown sugar into pork.; Place in deep roasting pan. Sprinkle well with salt and pepper.; Then add tomatoes, onion, Tabasco, catsup and water to the pan.; Baste often with the mixture while baking.; Roast in open roasting pan at 300° for 3 1/2 hours or until well done.; Serves 8 to 10..
The directions of Pork Roast are: Trim fat from roast.
column2: Place in pan and pierce with a long fork..

column1: The directions of Curry Chicken Salad are: Mix all ingredients except Miracle Whip and nuts and refrigerate for 3 hours.
column2: Fold in Miracle Whip and nuts before serving.
